mentions.name: Rolling coin identifier
mentions.description: A device that identifies coins as they roll by, detecting not just denomination but also variations and mint marks. The project involves building custom hardware, which is new territory for the builder.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Identifying coins as they roll by. Not just denomination, but variations and mint marks.

It's a fun project, because I have to do hardware for it, and that's outside of my current skill set.
